pi-packages

Dependency overrides need removal conditions

Repo-level overrides fork upstream dependency decisions. Without a removal condition they persist silently and can break installs if upstream moves to a semver-incompatible release.

Overrides (pnpm-workspace.yaml)

  1. undici: "8.9.0" because the coding agent pins an older release.
    • Removal condition: drop when the coding agent repins undici at or above 8.9.0.
  2. brace-expansion: "5.0.9", arriving via minimatch below the fixed release.
    • Removal condition: drop when every minimatch resolution uses brace-expansion at or above 5.0.9.

Lifecycle rules

  • Re-check both removal conditions on every catalog or lockfile bump.
  • The repository contract test signals a removable override.
